description: This file defines constants for test file patterns and contains utility functions to identify specific test files based on pattern matching. It is used for organizing and filtering test files in a JavaScript/TypeScript project.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file is a unit configuration test file based on inclusion and exclusion patterns.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is among the list of bundled plugin dependent test files.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a file matches the boundary test files list.
